scientific_integrity.detail: All results are labelled synthetic audit inputs and saved logs.

practice_boundaries.detail: The Skill designs experiments and routes analysis; it makes no individual clinical decision.

methodological_ground.detail: Fresh tests stop complete confounding, retain batch for partial imbalance, and make the bridge imbalance explicit.

code_usability.detail: All four shipped R files parsed, every substantive designit/SVA/ComBat route produced checked outputs, and the isolated R process exited cleanly.

maintainability.note: Runnable work is separated into two layouts and one shared verifier.

agent_specific.note: Precise triggers, reproducible seeds, validation, and downstream escape hatches.

recommendations.title: Treat the bridge-layout site warning as a non-acceptance signal
recommendations.problem: The supplied synthetic bridge run has a site spread of two although all hard constraints pass.
recommendations.root_cause: The fixed-seed synthetic bridge assignment satisfies hard constraints but does not optimize site balance below the documented warning threshold.
recommendations.fix: Before a real placement is accepted, re-run the documented optimizer with a different seed or higher max_iter until every declared covariate has acceptable balance.
